_readme: Neutral test fixture: a fictional HR product, 'Brightdesk HR'. Not a real product; every URL is on example.com. Loaded by tests/kb_fixture.py (in memory) or scripts/kb_import.py (into the database). Steps carry the passage they were drafted from, as ingested entries do.

entries.title: Apply for leave
questions: How do I apply for leave?
how to request time off in brightdesk
I want to apply for a vacation day, what are the steps?
entries.answer: You apply for leave from the Leave page; your manager then approves or declines the request.

steps.text: Open Leave from the left menu and click Apply Leave.
steps.quote: open Leave from the left menu and click Apply Leave

steps.text: Pick the leave type and the dates, then click Submit.
steps.quote: choose the leave type and the dates, then click Submit

entries.title: Install the mobile app on Android
questions: How do I install the Brightdesk app on my Android phone?
set up the mobile app on android
where can I download the app for android
entries.answer: The Android app is on Google Play; sign in with the same email you use on the web.

steps.text: Open Google Play and search for Brightdesk HR.
steps.quote: search for Brightdesk HR on Google Play

steps.text: Install the app and sign in with your work email.
steps.quote: install the app and sign in with your work email

entries.title: Install the mobile app on iOS
questions: How do I install the Brightdesk app on my iPhone?
set up the mobile app on ios
where can I download the app for ipad
entries.answer: The iOS app is on the App Store; sign in with the same email you use on the web.

steps.text: Open the App Store and search for Brightdesk HR.
steps.quote: search for Brightdesk HR on the App Store

steps.text: Install the app and sign in with your work email.
steps.quote: install the app and sign in with your work email

entries.title: Payslip not visible
questions: My payslip is not showing for this month
can't see my salary slip
payslip missing in payroll
entries.answer: Payslips appear only after payroll for the month is published by your HR team. If the month is published and the payslip is still missing, check the year filter on the Payslips page.

steps.quote: go to Payroll and open Payslips

steps.text: Set the year filter to the current year.
steps.quote: set the year filter to the current year

entries.title: Unable to sign in
collect: the email address you sign in with
a screenshot of the sign-in error
questions: I am unable to sign in to brightdesk
login fails with invalid credentials
cannot log in to my account
entries.answer:
Try the Forgot password link on the sign-in page first.
If that fails, take a screenshot of the error shown on the sign-in page.

entries.title: Export the attendance report
questions: How do I export the attendance report?
download timesheet report as excel
generate an attendance report for last month
entries.answer: Attendance reports can be exported as CSV or Excel from the Reports page.

steps.text: Pick the date range and click Export.
steps.quote: pick the date range and click Export

entries.title: Connect Slack
questions: How do I connect Brightdesk to Slack?
set up the slack integration
send leave approvals to slack
entries.answer: An admin connects Slack from the Integrations page; approvals are then posted to the chosen channel.

steps.text: Open Settings, then Integrations, and click Connect next to Slack.
steps.quote: go to Settings > Integrations and click Connect next to Slack

steps.text: Choose the channel for approvals and click Save.
steps.quote: choose the channel for approvals and click Save

entries.title: Submit an expense claim
questions: How do I submit an expense claim?
claim a reimbursement for travel
add an expense with a receipt
entries.answer: Expense claims are submitted from the Expenses page with the receipt attached.

steps.text: Open Expenses and click New Claim.
steps.quote: open Expenses and click New Claim

steps.text: Attach the receipt, enter the amount and click Submit.
steps.quote: attach the receipt, enter the amount and click Submit

entries.title: Clock-in fails: location not available
questions: clock in fails with location not available
I cannot clock in, it says location error
attendance clock-in not working on the app
entries.answer: Clock-in needs location access when your company uses geofencing. Allow location for the app in your phone settings and try again.

steps.text: Allow location access for Brightdesk HR in your phone settings.
steps.quote: allow location access for Brightdesk HR in your phone settings

entries.title: Change the subscription plan
questions: How do I change our subscription plan?
upgrade to the premium plan
downgrade the number of employee licences
entries.answer: Only the account owner can change the plan, from Billing in Settings.

steps.text: Open Settings, then Billing, and click Change Plan.
steps.quote: open Settings > Billing and click Change Plan
